title: New upper and lower bounds on covering codes K_q(n,R) for alphabets of size 5 <= q <= 21
summary: Let K_q(n,R) denote the minimum cardinality of a q-ary code of length n with covering radius R. We improve the known bounds on K_q(n,R) in 83 cases (82 distinct cells). On the upper-bound side we give 25 improved bounds for 5 = 5 since the 2011 revision of Keri's tables; several bounds decrease by more than 20%, e.g. K_6(8,4)<=166 (previously 216) and K_8(10,5)<=1883 (previously 2461).
